title: Aerodynamic analysis of a re-entry capsule.
author: Rodrigo Vieira Miranda

advisors.name: Nide Geraldo do Couto Ramos Fico Júnior

abstract: The objective of the study is to investigate the viscous effects and the influence of the angle attack on the base flow of the reentry capsule SARA. The initial point for the discussion are Navier Stokes calculations considering laminar as well as turbulent boundary layers and Euler simulations. They are performed with the DLR Euler and Navier Stokes code TAU applying unstructured grids.
